ai_assessment.method: Full direct Russian-to-Vietnamese comparison of all 92 canonical passages and both titles. A separate-context assessor (same model family, not shown the drafter’s notes or scores) read every pair first and reported 0 major and 16 minor findings with a pre-revision weighted score of 8.85; the drafter revised the text, re-read the changed passages and the whole target for naturalness, then assigned these final scores bound to the final byte hashes.
ai_assessment.limitations: The same AI system drafted, revised and assessed the work; the separate-context pass is correlated same-model feedback, not independent review or model diversity. No human literary reviewer, native-reader trial or measured reader demand is claimed. Existing Vietnamese translations were not consulted or collated. Scores are subjective and uncalibrated; missed errors may remain. Source clearance is separately recorded and is not granted by this review.

findings.explanation: The last line restores захватил: the grave equals ‘phần đất anh chiếm được từ chân đến đầu’, echoing his seizing of land; ác-sin spelled with its tone.
The red-rooster arson threat made legible (“gà trống đỏ” — đốt nhà anh) and the мир pun kept (chỗ đứng giữa làng xóm).
поспорим as a contest (thử sức); завидно as envy (ghen tị); the single Devil kept active in 2.3 (Ma quỷ nó chia rẽ họ).
разгорелось сердце / разгорелись глаза unified around rực.
сапоги consistently ủng; small naturalness fixes in 2.1, 2.8, 6.2, 6.8, 6.22 and 8.8.
Con người cần bao nhiêu đất? chosen over Một người…: the rhetorical question concerns humankind.

summary: Full assessment of all 92 Russian/Vietnamese passages and both titles. The sisters’ quarrel, Pakhom’s boast overheard by the Devil, the purchases and lawsuits, the move to the Volga, the Bashkir steppe, the dream of the Devil laughing, the day-long walk round the land and the three-arshin grave are complete and in order. The separate-context pass found no major issue; its sixteen minor findings were revised, most importantly restoring the land-seizing echo in the last line. Fidelity, voice, imagery and mechanics are 9.0, naturalness 8.5. Unrounded weighted score 8.925 meets the unchanged 8.6 threshold. No unresolved major or critical issue remains.

title_review.target_title: Con người cần bao nhiêu đất?
title_review.rationale: Con người cần bao nhiêu đất? renders Tolstoy’s rhetorical question for humankind in general; the story’s last line answers it.
